name: The Grave Wyrm's Claim
vestige: Tarakamedes, the dragon in the grave
summary: Animate Dead and Speak with Dead once per long rest each, and resistance to cold. The price: Disadvantage on every death saving throw.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: The dead hear you and get up when you ask. The grave's cold no longer bites, because it knows you.

cost.flaw: The grave has your name written down now. When you fall, it pulls.
cost.text: A dragon sleeps in the dark under everything, and it has been promised you.
